# Draft:R/nfcsouthmemewar

----
r/nfcsouthmemewar is a meme subreddit on the popular content sharing application:Reddit.It was originally founded to make fun of all of the teams in the NFC south division which resides in the NFC conference,and the league the NFL. Popular memes at this current time period include but not limited to: Brick Yamg, 3&28, 28-3, and memes about the Saints being the Saints.
